name: steering-pack
title: Project steering pack
for_each: select id,name from projects order by name

sections.title: Approved budget and delivery
sections.sql: select name,currency,budget,approved_budget,round(actual_cost,2) actual_cost,approved_finish from portfolio_status where id=$1

sections.title: Milestones
sections.sql: select name,owner,baseline_finish,finish_date,percent_complete,evidence from tasks where project_id=$1 and milestone order by finish_date

sections.title: Risks
sections.sql: select name,owner,likelihood*impact score,mitigation,review_due,status from risks where project_id=$1 order by review_due

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_date,outcome from decisions where project_id=$1 order by due_date

name: change-request
title: Change request and decision
for_each: select id,name from changes order by name

sections.title: Scope, cost and decision
sections.sql: select p.name project,p.currency,c.name,c.reason,c.requested_by,c.cost_delta,c.finish_delta_days,c.status,c.decided_by,c.decision_note from changes c join projects p on p.id=c.project_id where c.id=$1

name: closure-record
title: Closure and benefits record
for_each: select id,name from projects where status='closed' order by name
